entries.title: PostReady: PR #771 — fix: Finishing touches layout — tiles fit one row, location link no longer clips
entries.description: Fixed the Finishing touches section layout in the Carousel Creator so all tile controls fit on one row and the location link no longer clips off-screen.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #773 — fix: compact the Pro Prompt strip — button on the right, single row
entries.description: Compacted the Pro Prompt strip on the Create tab so the action button sits on the right side in a single row, reducing vertical space and improving the layout.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #772 — Image prompt tune-up + Seedream 5.0 readiness (behind the flag)
entries.description: Tuned image prompt generation for better output quality and added Seedream 5.0 model readiness behind a feature flag, preparing PostReady for the next-generation image model.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #774 — Carousel caption + hashtag generation (backend) — E6
entries.description: Added backend AI generation of captions and hashtags for the Carousel Creator (epic #663 workstream E6), enabling users to auto-generate on-brand copy for each carousel directly from the editor.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #775 — Carousel drag-and-drop: file drop onto a card + distinct affordances
entries.description: Completed carousel drag-and-drop support: users can now drop image files directly onto individual cards, with distinct visual affordances to distinguish drag areas from card content.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #776 — G1 · Bring to Life UX & terminology (Motion Post picker)
entries.description: Shipped the first milestone of the Bring to Life feature: UX and terminology update introducing the Motion Post picker, giving users a clear entry point for animating static posts into video clips.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #777 — Default Bring to Life flag OFF until the engine ships
entries.description: Set the Bring to Life feature flag to OFF by default so the UX and picker UI are gated until the underlying video-animation engine is production-ready.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #778 — Wire up carousel caption + hashtag generation UI
entries.description: Connected the carousel caption and hashtag generation backend to the Carousel Creator UI, so users can generate on-brand captions and hashtags for each slide directly from the editor.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #779 — Full-carousel generation with narrative structure (#687)
entries.description: Shipped full-carousel AI generation with a narrative structure — the entire carousel is generated as a cohesive story arc rather than independent per-card prompts, improving content coherence.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #780 — F1: platform-aware carousel limits (config, not hardcoded)
entries.description: Replaced hardcoded carousel slide limits with a platform-aware config system (F1), so per-platform maximums (LinkedIn, Instagram, etc.) can be managed centrally without code changes.
